static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友和家人的Relationship tension,因自责与羞耻而自我隔离
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;not yet接受过心理治疗;without类似问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,条理性较好;能具体描述事件与情绪;语气平稳但Low mood;配合度较好;自我批评明显

basic_info.main_problem: Experiences strong guilt and self-blame because the dog ran away from home, believing she is the 'worst pet owner in the world'.
basic_info.core_demands: 因狗狗离家出走导致的压倒性的Guilt and self-blame使我overwhelmed,因此寻求咨询.

core_beliefs: I am the worst pet owner

special_situations.event: When the dog ran out of the house, I was distracted looking at my phone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not时刻保持注意力确保宠物安全,就说明我是一个not负责任,失败的主人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly blames themselves, recalls the details of the incident, and intensifies the search (posting posters, visiting neighbors, posting on social media)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我当时not看手机,Max就not会跑掉;It is all my fault,我是最差的主人

special_situations.event: Every time thinking of the dog or seeing other pet owners interact with their pets
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not像其他主人那样时刻把控一切,就not配养宠物
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 与他人比较,Avoids socializing以躲避羞耻感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not配养宠物,我就是个糟糕的主人

special_situations.event: 每天过去仍not yet找到狗狗
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能迅速把他找回,就证明我在持续失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Intensifies self-criticism; immersed in negative emotions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I feel worse and worse; this means I really am a complete failure

special_situations.event: 想到自己正在Work而have not投入全部时间去寻找狗狗
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须not停地做更多,否则就not负责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Berates himself with 'should/must' standards, sacrificing rest and social life
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该做得更多,如果have not做更多,我就是not负责任的主人

core_conflict.wish: Longs to guard and maintain a stable attachment relationship with the pet, and to be seen as a responsible caregiver worthy of being loved / trusted
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因自身疏忽而失去重要关系与自我价值,被他人或自己视为not称职
defense_goal: 通过Reinforcement自我责备来维持对事件的控制感与道德感
Avoiding shame and external evaluation by keeping distance and self-isolating

object_relations.object_representation: A pet let down by oneself, fragile and needing protection

object_relations.self_representation: not配与他人互动,低价值的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Groups of others/pet owners who are more responsible and will evaluate oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests contacting family/friends for support or discussing self-care
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者担心一旦开口会暴露自己'not称职'的一面,认为他人会对其负面评价(移情:将自我批判投向他人视角)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责性的语言表达(如'It is all my fault'),降低自我价值,拒绝或推迟求助,语气克制,避免深入他人支持.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a concrete action plan and evaluates pros and cons
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者将结果以非黑即白方式理解:若not yet完全找回宠物即视为彻底失败
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用绝对化,全或without的措辞回应(如'要么找回Max,要么我就是最差的主人'),语气紧张,忽略中间可能性.

manifestations: Self-isolates; avoids contact with friends and family
Finds it hard to express inner feelings to family and friends, afraid of exposing a 'failed' self
被'应该/必须做得更多'的Introjection价值所束缚,体验到责任压力与自我苛责
难以容许not完美与有限性
outcomes: Life rhythm out of balance, body-mind load increased

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use'应该/必须'自我苛责的语言
Judges whether she is competent by external ideal standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 强烈自责与自我批评,认为自己not配开口求助
Contacting others with excessive caution, worried about exposing a 'failure' image

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Could have sought support from friends and family but instead turns to self-blame and inner torment
Reduces outgoing expression and help-seeking under shame

positive_force: Deep affection and sense of responsibility for the pet
Still takes proactive action under high pressure (posting posters, visiting neighbors, contacting shelters)
Has a certain tendency toward realistic problem solving (willing to evaluate options and make plans)
Has potential support resources (several friends and one sister)
negative_force: Strong guilt and self-blame tendency (personalization, absolutization)
自我隔离与回避求助,Social withdrawal
Sleep and diet affected,精力与Reduced work focus
Rigid 'should/must' standards leading to excessive self-harshness

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent rumination of self-blame and guilt
antecedent: Seeing other pet owners interact with their pets
Being distracted at work triggers associations with the event
target_behavior.core_reason: 事件trigger强烈的责任归因与个人化,非黑即白的认知模式('It is all my fault''我是最差的主人')
target_behavior.function: 通过自我批评维持控制感与道德感,避免面对外界评价与not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance,insomnia与食欲减退,Interpersonal tension与自我隔离,Increased emotional burden

antecedent: Anticipation他人可能询问或评价事件
想到向亲友表达内心时的not适
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被他人视为not称职,内化高标准的'应该',导致羞耻与not配感
target_behavior.function: 逃避羞耻与潜在的负面评价,短期减轻Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Weakened support system,Interpersonal tension,情绪困扰维持甚至加重
